messages:
samira: Heads up — prod-usw2 GPU warm pool failing to join after last night's VPC egress ACL change. Nodes stuck at 'Waiting for KMS handshake'.
kevin: seeing the same. KMS proxy is returning 403 for the decrypt handshake, logs show 'AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt' from 10.32.14.0/22.
aj: @samira can you paste the snippet from the proxy logs? I want to check whether it's mutual TLS or IAM condition blocking.
samira: paste: ```2026-03-22T04:12:01Z proxy[kms-proxy]: request id=abc123 peer=10.32.14.12 tls_peer_cert=null authorization=DENIED reason="principal missing: projects/serviceAccount:gpu-joiner@redwood-inference"```
kevin: that TLS_peer_cert=null bit looks like mTLS expectation failed. The egress ACL that went out last night routes those nodes via the new privatelink NAT; maybe it stripped client cert forwarding.
infra-bot: deploy-notify: rollback window open for egress-acl-change (change id: CID-3829). Ping @ops_lead to approve emergency rollback.
natalie: If we rollback, join will succeed but audit logs will resume spinning up at ~2.8x. Cost hit discussions in #finance later.
aj: short-term mitigation: add a targeted allowlist to accept connections from the GPU subnet to the KMS proxy endpoint, but keep logging filters at sampling=5% to reduce volume. That requires IAM exception on the proxy that we can opt-in via tag.
maria: can we bounce the proxy instead? Restart won't help if the client certs are dropped upstream. Need to verify NAT path.
kevin: confirmed: packet capture on a joining node -> outbound to proxy shows TLS ClientHello with no cert. The kernel TLS stack is fine; the path via the privatelink NAT drops the SNI->cert mapping (we see TCP NAT translation from ephemeral port range).
ops_lead: decision time — rollback ACL or open allowlist. What about a hybrid: open allowlist for the GPU subnet for 30m to let backlog drain, then rollback ACL in a controlled window with pager on-call? Also set audit retention to 7d for the window to cap cost.
samira: favor hybrid. We need minimal blast radius. I'll open an allowlist entry + set log sampling to 10% for auth success events.
aj: I'll prepare the proxy IAM exception and the allowlist CIDR entry now. @kevin can you validate join after I flip it?
kevin: standing by. I can validate with test node and watch /var/log/gpu-join.log.
infra-bot: action-created: allowlist-add(CIDR=10.32.14.0/22) by samira. proxy-iam-exception draft by aj.
maria: ops checklist: (1) allowlist add, (2) proxy iam exception deploy, (3) smoke join 2 nodes, (4) monitor join rate + audit volume, (5) revert sampling and remove allowlist within 30m if stable.
ops_lead: please tag the change with incident:INC-2026-03-22 and follow change freeze policy. Keep finance in the loop about retention delta.
samira: doing steps 1-3 now. I'll post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: join succeeded on smoke node. KMS decrypts now. Monitoring warm pool; backlog at ~18 nodes and decreasing.
natalie: estimate on audit cost: if we keep retention at default 30d during the window, expect ~ $600 extra. If we drop to 7d for the 1h window it's ~ $120. Suggest 7d.
ops_lead: set retention 7d for that proxy logs, set sampling back to baseline after 30m. Good runbook item to add.
samira: everything looks stable after 22m. I'm scheduling the ACL rollback tomorrow in a noon maintenance with ops on-call. Adding runbook notes to incident doc.
aj: filing follow-up: (1) update privatelink NAT to preserve client cert metadata, (2) test egress path in staging with mTLS, (3) add automated canary that tries KMS handshake on new egress routes.
maria: and add a billing guardrail to auto-reduce retention when sampling spikes >x%.
ops_lead: nice work team. Closing the emergency thread, keeping incident open until tomorrow's rollback. :thumbsup:
